value.rationale: The originating 2024 paper motivates and numerically sketches the beta-dependent first period doubling and reports increasing absolute parameter ranges. The exact all-real-beta threshold resolves numerical 4.95/5.35 values, proves a stable two-cycle with amplitude and critical clock, and shows that the fixed-point stability window occupies vanishing fraction e/beta of the admissible range even while its absolute threshold rises toward e^2. This provides a concrete asymptotic calibration for parameter selection and an exact Ricker universality boundary, beyond a simple renamed textbook flip.
